findings.title: Return type changed without call-site update
findings.body: The function now returns `dict[str, list[Slot]]` instead of `list[Slot]`, but `clinic/booking.book_first_free` on line 10 calls `open_slots(day)` and then accesses `slots[0]` and `slot.doctor`, which will raise `TypeError` because the new return is a dictionary. Update the call site to handle the new structure.

findings.title: Manual grouping loop can be replaced by defaultdict
findings.body: The loop on lines 17–20 builds a dictionary by doctor using `setdefault`, which is less idiomatic than using `collections.defaultdict(list)`. Replace with `by_doctor: defaultdict[list[Slot]] = defaultdict(list)` and `by_doctor[slot.doctor].append(slot)`.

summary.problem: The function’s return type changed from list to dict without updating the sole call site, breaking downstream code.
summary.done_well: The new implementation groups slots by doctor and includes a clear docstring.
